observations.caption: Use the scope to inspect the supplied path. Both the aligned existing corridor and the alternate surveyed corridor are viable. Check that band, channel and PHY match at both endpoints, then measure the selected setup.
observations.alt: A brass alignment scope looks across a clear gap between two facing dishes on basalt ledges.

observations.caption: In the surveyed channel A example the receiver sees −65 dBm signal and −90 dBm noise. Subtract the two comparable levels to obtain 25 dB SNR. This worked example supplies neither a current measurement nor a throughput estimate.
observations.alt: Two independently movable brass markers sit on separate rails of the same instrument.

observations.caption: Example field sheets: square stamp, 10 November, revision 4; round stamp, 12 November, revision 5. In your notebook, keep readings with their actual attempts and configuration revisions. A channel, path, settings or interference change makes the earlier reading stale. Take a new measurement. Revision order alone gives no elapsed time.
observations.alt: A portable analyzer rests beside two field cards. One has a folded corner and square stamp, the other a round stamp.

observations.caption: Compare the earlier radio reading with the later current reading, using their recorded signal and noise in dBm and SNR in dB. Weather is a sketch of the scene. The measured change alone establishes neither its cause nor throughput.
observations.alt: Two diary pages show the same dish facing the same peaks, under clear skies and driving rain. A blank strip waits below each view.

observations.caption: A fitting shell is the first check. Compare host support, PHY, medium and supported rate. For an optical pairing also check wavelength. Verify the power method, each occupied port and the delivered budget before approving a kit.
observations.alt: A hermit crab in a metal shell faces a fit gauge. Four slots hold a shell outline, a striped mode card, a loop of medium and a spectrum swatch.

observations.caption: The audit uses one 30 W allowance delivered after losses. The three endpoint demands at that same boundary are 12 W, 11 W and 10 W. Their 33 W total exceeds the allowance by 3 W. Recording this diagnosis changes no equipment.
observations.alt: The shell-shaped ledger has one brass allowance tray on the left and three separate endpoint demand tiles on the right.

observations.alt: The shell-shaped ledger has one brass allowance tray on the left and three separate endpoint demand tiles on the right.

observations.caption: Read the toy key left to right. Circle represents −3 → 00, triangle −1 → 01, square +1 → 10 and diamond +3 → 11. These are discrete toy levels. Sample positions determine the reading order. The example supplies no voltage scale or useful bitrate.
observations.alt: Four separate seals in left-to-right order have a circular, triangular, square and diamond-shaped border.

observations.caption: Both endpoints negotiate. A advertises 1000/full and 100/full. B advertises 100/full and 10/half. Only 100/full appears in both lists. Selecting it records their common mode. Endpoint service still needs a separate test.
observations.alt: Two fans of embossed cards lead to one central socket. The two cards nearest the socket share a three-point motif.

observations.caption: Inspect the damaged section and keep the chosen route, equipment and timing evidence together. The ordinary kit can prepare the repair. Review the exact plan and acknowledge its warning before execution. A preparation record alone changes no equipment.
observations.alt: An open brass clamp and a checklist with empty boxes stand behind two separated conduit ends on a workbench.

observations.caption: Copper, fiber and radio are alternative repair routes. Permanent installation removes the defect. A temporary bypass needs its limitation and follow-up. Deliberate isolation leaves a named fault unresolved and needs a recovery plan. Fresh link and endpoint checks are required to establish restored service.
observations.alt: Four separate panels show copper, fiber, radio and a disconnected section behind a barrier.

observations.caption: After intervention, retain the earlier preparation readings as stale. Measure the selected route again in the current attempt, then run the independent endpoint service test. A new card or a glowing link lamp alone cannot establish restoration.
observations.alt: Two validation cards lie side by side. The older card has a folded corner and a broad hatched band. The newer card has a clean edge and a circular seal.

observations.caption: Read the three outcome criteria. The Steady Light requires fresh passing service checks and permanent removal of the defect. The Borrowed Dawn records the same passing checks plus a temporary dependency, limitation and follow-up. The Honest Shutdown records a named unresolved fault, deliberate isolation and a recovery plan. Hints do not reduce a valid outcome.
observations.alt: Three folio leaves have different edges and scenes: a steady lantern, a braced span in the dawn and a closed gate.
